terms.meaning: a function passed in by the parent that runs at a certain moment
a choice where only one option can be picked
values a component remembers while the user interacts with it

sections.name: File setup, TicketOption
sections.title: Browser marker and option shape
sections.what: Marks the file for browser use, brings in React helpers and the Stamp, and describes one option with an id, a label and an optional detail.
sections.why: Likely reason: each option needs an id so the parent knows which one was chosen.

sections.name: TicketLock
sections.title: Saved lock record
sections.what: Describes a locked call: the chosen option and the confidence as a whole percentage.
sections.why: Likely reason: the shape the parent saves and passes back in.
sections.watch_out: Confidence here is a whole percent, but the anti-cheat file expects a fraction, so passing values straight across would be wrong.

sections.name: TicketProps
sections.title: Inputs the card needs
sections.what: Lists the question, context pairs, options, an optional saved lock, an optional lock callback that may reject with a message, and an optional meter.
sections.why: Likely reason: the parent supplies the data and handles saving.
sections.watch_out: A callback that never finishes leaves the card stuck in the locking state.

sections.name: Ticket
sections.title: Card behaviour and states
sections.what: Remembers the pick and confidence, starting at 60 unless a lock already exists, and moves between open, locking and locked. Lock does nothing without a pick or while busy. Success locks the card; failure shows the message and reopens it. Also shows the context, question, options, slider, Lock button and a note for screen readers.
sections.why: Likely reason: the state stops double submission and shows progress and failure clearly.
sections.watch_out: The starting state is read once, so a parent that later changes the saved lock will not update the card.

summary: The call card where a fan picks one option, sets how sure they are from 50 to 99 percent, and locks the call.
purpose: Collects the fan's decision and records it, showing it as locked once saved.
why: The comment describes the Ticket Call: context, a question, two or three options, confidence from 50 to 99 with a default of 60, and a Lock button.
how: Shows the context and question, an optional meter, the options as radio buttons, and a confidence slider, then a Lock button. Lock sends the pick and confidence to the parent. While waiting, the form is disabled. On success it shows the locked stamp. On failure it shows the error and reopens the form.
inputs: question, context pairs, options, an optional existing lock, an onLock callback, and an optional meter.
outputs: A card on screen, and a call to onLock with the pick and confidence.
risks: The existing lock is read only at first display, so later changes are ignored. The number of options is not checked. Error text appears only when the rejection is an Error object.
debug: If Lock stays disabled, check that an option is selected and the card is open. If a saved call shows as open, check the locked value passed at first display. If the error is generic, the parent did not reject with an Error.
